questions.prompt: Why does the model see only names and descriptions, not the full text of every skill?
options: The full texts would fill much of the window on every request, though most tasks use none of them
The catalogue is faster to write to disk
questions.explanation: With three skills, the full texts are 9,600 tokens while the catalogue is about 120. The model loads only the skill it needs.

questions.prompt: The model calls skill with a name that is not in the catalogue. What happens?
options: The harness returns an empty text
The tool throws, so the model gets an error result it can read
questions.explanation: execute throws for an unknown name. The pipeline turns that into an error result, so the model can try a listed name.

questions.prompt: What must a SKILL.md file have for the harness to list it?
options: A name and a description in its YAML header
questions.explanation: The catalogue is built from the name and description in the header, so a file without them is ignored.
